subject: Re: Product SKU bundling & brand control — Orchard Studio integration
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.park@orchard.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Qureshi <samir@oraops.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Orchard Studio — in-product inference engine partnership

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this. Quick background: Orchard Studio is a desktop-focused content-assistant used by 15k creative teams. We want to offer a built-in generative assistant in our product and are evaluating options to bundle an inference engine under our product SKU.

High-level asks:
- We need an option to ship with the model/runtime built into our installer for offline customers (air-gapped enterprise).
- For cloud customers, we want an SDK that can call Redwood but surface the UI as Orchard-native (minimal Redwood branding).
- Commercial ask: looking for a revenue-share or per-seat wholesale SKU.
- Security: SOC2 evidence + a short certification checklist for embedding the runtime.

I'll attach a short outline (partner-integration-outline.docx). Can we get a call next week to talk technical constraints and a commercial starting point?

—Angela
Angela Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, Orchard AI
angela.park@orchard.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@orchard.ai>
Cc: Samir Qureshi <samir@oraops.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Studio — in-product inference engine partnership

Hi Angela — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the outline — shared to the team.

Quick summary of options we can offer (short version):
1) Hosted SDK (recommended start): your UI calls Redwood’s hosted inference via API keys. Supports co-branding or a "Powered by Redwood" badge. Fastest go-to-market; we can offer a partner pricing tier + revenue share.
2) Dedicated / Reserved Pool: we provision a dedicated GPU pool with your tenancy for predictable performance and per-token pricing; minimal branding exposure (your customers see a Redwood service but we can co-manage support).
3) Private (on-prem/VPC) package: for offline/air-gapped customers we provide a deployable runtime bundle + licensing (requires on-prem packaging and certification). This is a higher-touch commercial model and includes a certification fee.

Branding note: we are flexible with co-branded badges and allowed API surface, but full white-label (zero Redwood attribution) requires higher commercial commitment and a custom legal addendum.

Next steps I propose:
- Technical deep-dive with Ben (SE) to validate offline requirements and latency targets.
- Commercial sketch from Karthik (partner pricing) — ballpark numbers to set expectations.
- Partner certification checklist (attached: redwood-partner-cert-checklist.pdf).

Availability: I can do a call Wed/Thu next week. What works for you?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Orchard Studio — in-product inference engine partnership

Vanessa — thanks. A couple quick commercial clarifications from Orchard:
- Revenue share: what bands do you typically offer for a hosted SDK vs a private deploy? Our finance team prefers revenue-share over fixed per-seat pricing.
- Minimum committed monthly spend (MCMS) if we go dedicated or hosted partner pricing?
- SLA / incident escalation: for in-product features we need clear SLAs (p95 latency, availability) and an escalation path for enterprise customers.

If you can share a short commercial sketch ahead of the call that would help.

—Samir
CTO (OraOps, embedded at Orchard)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Angela Park <angela.park@orchard.ai>, Samir Qureshi <samir@oraops.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Orchard Studio — technical integration notes

Attaching a short tech note (runtime-integration-technical-notes.md) — highlights for the Orchard team:
- Hosted SDK: expects JSON over TLS, streaming supported; typical P95 token latency = 180–350ms for 2k contexts on G5-like capacity; recommend a request-side timeout of 2s for UI UX.
- Dedicated Pool: we can reserve capacity for peak usage; autoscaling available but cold-starts for large models may add 1–3s.
- Private bundle: we ship a runtime package compatible with x86_64 Linux and an installer for air-gapped clients. Private requires quantization (4-bit) and explicit license for weights; on-prem customers must run a small telemetry stub (opt-in) for security patches unless they request fully air-gapped operation (then updates via signed packages).
- Costing drivers: tokens served, KV cache hit-rate, prefix caching. For in-product calls, client-side caching of common prompts reduces token count materially.

Open technical questions for the call: recommended model size for desktop (latency vs quality), offline storage size, and update cadence for on-prem customers.

—Ben (SE)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Angela Park <angela.park@orchard.ai>, Samir Qureshi <samir@oraops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial sketch — Orchard Studio integration (ballpark)

Team / Orchard — here's a simple starting commercial framework to unblock the conversation. These are negotiable and intended as starting points:

Option A — Co-branded Hosted SDK (fastest):
- Partner retains 80% of net revenue from Orchard-branded subscriptions that use the integrated assistant; Redwood takes 20% revenue share.
- No MCMS for first 6 months; then 3-month rolling minimum based on historical run-rate.
- Support: Standard partner SLA (24/7 incident triage + business-hours remediation).

Option B — Unbranded (white-label) Hosted or Dedicated SKU:
- Partner retains 70% of net revenue; Redwood takes 30% revenue share.
- Minimum annual commitment (example: $250k ARR committed) and a one-time certification fee ($45k) for full white-label rights.
- For private/on-prem deployments, licensing includes an additional per-instance maintenance fee and a technical enablement retainer.

Notes on brand control: full suppression of a Redwood badge is allowed only under Option B with legal addendum and audit rights. Co-branded integration ("Powered by Redwood") is standard under Option A.

If Orchard is comfortable with Option A we can provision a partner sandbox immediately and kick off certification for enterprise customers. For Option B we will draft a white-label addendum and SOW (draft attached: partner-pricing-teaser.xlsx).

—Karthik
Director, Commercial Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Angela / Samir — great progress. Based on our call and the notes above, Orchard indicated preference for Option A to start (co-branded hosted SDK) and to move to Option B for select enterprise customers who require white-label/on-prem later.

Attached: draft-sow-revenue-exhibit.pdf (for review). I’ve also initiated a signature flow for the partner framework and MOU — DocuSign link below. Once we have the MOU in place we will:
- Provision a partner sandbox with a limited hosted tier for Orchard (API keys + test capacity).
- Kick off certification track for enterprise/offline customers (Ben will lead tech cert).
- Schedule a commercial review in 30 days to evaluate usage and discuss white-label SOW triggers.
